name: duplicate-property-key
comment: KnowledgeElementVersion whose property map contains the same key twice. JSON objects cannot express duplicate keys, so this case is exercised as a constructed Rust value in tests/structural_invalid.rs.
reason: property map contains a duplicate key
note: Not representable as a JSON object; enforced by tests/structural_invalid.rs using a Vec<(String, PropertyValue)> with duplicate keys.
